title: "prelim-analysis"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidydr)

# loading data
participants = read.csv(here::here("data","participants.csv"))
participants

vaccine_hist = read.csv(here::here("data", "participant_vaccineHistory.csv"))

flow_outcome = read.csv(here::here("data","publicData_ex_vivo_flow.csv"))
rnaSeq_2024 = read.csv(here::here("data","publicData_rnaseq_2024_UGA.csv"))

saveRDS(rnaSeq_2024, here::here("data", "rnaseq.rds"))

flow_outcome

# filtering on patients who have a 7 day plasmablast signal
flow_outcome = flow_outcome%>%
  filter(
    name == "Antibody-secreting_cells_(ASC)",
    timepoint == 7
  )

flow_outcome

# identifying the same patients with an exposure signal in RNAseq
common_ids <- intersect(
  flow_outcome$participant_id,
  rnaSeq_2024$participant_id
)
length(common_ids)
```

```{r}

# visualizing some data

cohort = participants[participants$participant_id %in% common_ids,]

cohort = cohort %>%
  inner_join(flow_outcome, by = "participant_id") %>%
  select(-subject.x) %>%
  rename(subject = subject.y)

vaccine_hist_agg = vaccine_hist %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  summarise(
    n_prior_vax = sum(received %in% c("Yes_selfReported","Yes_Study"))
  )


cohort = left_join(cohort, vaccine_hist_agg, by = "subject")
cohort = cohort %>%
  mutate(n_prior_vax = coalesce(n_prior_vax,0))

cohort
cohort$log_freq = log(cohort$value)

plasmablast_propo_hist = ggplot(cohort, aes(x = log_freq)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 29, fill = "#4C72B0", colour = "white", alpha = 0.9) + 
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of plasmablast frequency at day 7",
    subtitle = paste0("n = ", nrow(cohort), " participants"),
    x = "Plasmablast frequency (%)",
    y = "Number of participants"
  ) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
plasmablast_propo_hist
```

```{r}

# age hist
age_box <- ggplot(cohort, aes(x = "", y = age)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#4C72B0", colour = "grey20", alpha = 0.6,
               width = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 2, alpha = 0.7, colour = "grey20") +
  labs(
    title    = "Distribution of age among cohort",
    subtitle = paste0("n = ", nrow(cohort), " participants"),
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Age (years)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "grey40"),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
age_box
```

```{r}
# age hist
# Number of prior vaccinations
p_prior_vax <- ggplot(cohort, aes(x = n_prior_vax)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#4C72B0", colour = "white", alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:max(cohort$n_prior_vax, na.rm = TRUE)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Number of previous vaccinations",
    subtitle = paste0("n = ", nrow(cohort), " participants"),
    x        = "Number of prior seasonal influenza vaccinations",
    y        = "Number of participants"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "grey40"),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

p_prior_vax

```

```{r}
p_sex <- ggplot(cohort, aes(x = biological_sex)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#4C72B0", colour = "white", alpha = 0.9, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(stat = "count",
            aes(label = paste0(after_stat(count), " (",
                               round(100 * after_stat(count) / nrow(cohort)), "%)")),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Sex distribution of the cohort",
    subtitle = paste0("n = ", nrow(cohort), " participants"),
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Number of participants"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "grey40"),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

p_sex
```
